caption: The Numbers sample view shows the reading comparisons.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['bases-row-deltas']; p.pro.signOut(); await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Row Deltas/Readings.base#Numbers','',false); for(let i=0;i<100;i++){ const v=[...p.views].filter(v=>v.containerEl.isConnected && v.containerEl.offsetParent!==null && v.containerEl.dataset.brdView==="Numbers").pop(); if(v && v.containerEl.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length===3) return 'ready'; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); } throw new Error('Sample rows did not render');})()
